answer: Release earnings through a slow escrow horizon: only 10% of each epoch's income unlocks at once, while the remaining 90% vests linearly over the next 30 epochs, so a sybil farm cannot cash out before it is caught. The escrow kernel is a beacon registry: every payout references a beacon that timestamps the agent's first activity, and identities younger than 14 epochs vest at half speed. Running 100 fake agents costs 100 30-epoch waits for the same payout, while one honest agent keeps the full stream. If a beacon timestamp is forged, a challenger can freeze that escrow and force re-verification.
